interpretation: Full grammar-skeleton structure alone does not extrapolate reliably to all unseen wrapper/position forms. However, once an opaque code span has been learned automatically through behavioral grounding, exact learned code membership can serve as a semantic interface anchor; combining that evidence with structural scoring recovered all seven held-out grammar forms in this controlled screen.
claim_boundary: This is not zero-shot semantic discovery of a completely new command phrase. The held-out command code has already been behaviorally calibrated, although its evaluation wrapper/position grammar is absent from the unlabeled structural corpus. Exact token-pair membership is used as semantic evidence. Natural-language paraphrases that change the command surface form remain untested.
